note: review: ReadTokenSpec now pins 0x00/0x08/0x09/0x0f, the int and UID widths, 0x22/0x23 and the unknown-token refusal (:640-641), but its 0x33 conjunct only restates the branch as deltaFromSeconds then epochPlus, and DateWholeSeconds pins those helpers for integral f alone, so a reader that truncated or rounded f to whole seconds satisfies every entry, while CPython keeps or rounds microseconds by f's precision (1900-01-01 00:00:00.000001 comes back exactly, 2300-01-01 00:00:00.000001 as .000002, year 9000 loses it; measured on 3.15.2), a window no theorem states.
